claims.claim: LG DirectDrive 7kg washing machine for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a white LG front-load washer with “LG” on the control panel and “DirectDrive 7Kg” text visible (photo 0).

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (cannot confirm it powers on, heats, spins, or completes a full cycle).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the machine powering on, selecting a wash program, running through at least the wash and spin stages, and ending normally.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-tested/possibly faulty (worst case: not working or unreliable).

risks.risk: Rust/oxidation and dirt stains near the lower front edge and around the door area may indicate corrosion, water ingress, or poor maintenance.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rusted areas plus a clip showing the base area after a short run (to see if new water leakage appears).
risks.if_unproven: Price at a lower tier due to visible corrosion/wear.

risks.risk: Potential drum/interior issues (photos only show the door window; drum condition, mold, or damage not visible).
risks.proof: Photo of the drum interior with the door fully open, showing the drum surface and rubber seal condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown interior condition (worst case: needs cleaning or has wear).

risks.risk: Leakage or drainage problems (hoses, drain pump/filter, and base condition not shown).
risks.proof: Photos of hoses and the back/bottom area, plus a clip showing draining after a short cycle.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (inlet/outlet hoses, manual, or other components not shown).
risks.proof: Photo checklist showing included items: inlet hose, drain hose, power cable condition, and any accessories/manual.

risks.risk: Exact model number/serial not readable; could be a different variant with different parts/availability.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating plate/serial label (back or side panel) with readable text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown variant within the stated series.

proof_requests: Video: power on + start a full short wash program and show it reaching spin and finishing.
Close-up photos of the rust/oxidation areas and the door seal/rim.
Photo of the drum interior with the door fully open.
Photos of hoses and the back/bottom area; show the drain hose connection.
Video clip showing draining after a short cycle.
Clear photo of the rating plate/serial number label.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as an LG DirectDrive 7kg front-load washing machine, so it can be priced at its worst-case condition; however, operation, leaks, and drum/drain health are not verifiable from the shown images.
